snippet.title: Thieves & Gold: Smash, Steal, Upgrade!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Thieves and Gold on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4452620

Thieves and Gold is coming to Steam 💰🗝️

Thieves and Gold is a new indie single-player incremental heist game coming in Q3 2026.

Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in fast medieval loot runs. Raid treasure-filled rooms, break furniture, crates, and chests, collect relics, and push your luck before time or greed ends the run.

Demo planned for May 2026.

Press kit:

https://impress.games/press-kit/rzv/thieves-and-gold

Website:

https://thievesandgold.com/

Join the community on Discord:

https://discord.com/invite/CxyAFPH2PB

Follow development:

https://bsky.app/profile/thievesandgold.bsky.social

👉 Wishlist Thieves and Gold on Steam and follow for more updates.

#ThievesAndGold #IndieGame #SteamGame
